name: OmaMood
author: defkode
description: Tuya Wi-Fi lamps in the Omarchy bar, over your LAN: power, brightness and colour; the lamp follows your wallpaper or theme accent, blinks when a terminal rings its bell, and dims when you're away. One QR scan with the Smart Life app sets it up; no developer account, no cloud after setup.

barWidget.description: A bulb tinted with your lamp's colour. The panel switches lamps on and off, sets brightness, white or a theme colour, and adds lamps by QR code.

schema.label: On theme change, colour the lamp from
schema.description: Needs the theme hook (the panel offers to install it). Lamps that are off stay off.

schema.label: Minimum saturation for theme colours (%)
schema.description: Muted palettes look white on an LED; this lifts them while keeping the hue. Greys always become white.

schema.label: Blink when a terminal rings its bell
schema.description: When a terminal in the background asks for attention (a finished build, an AI agent waiting for you), the lamp flashes three times and returns to what it was.

schema.label: Window classes that may trigger the blink
schema.description: Comma-separated Hyprland window classes; * for any window.

schema.label: When the computer sleeps
schema.description: off: lamps turn off before suspend and come back as they were after resume.

schema.label: Tint the bar icon with the lamp's colour
